verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents an amount-splits feature configured on the payin, so the product itself offers some charge-splitting. The evidence does not show how far it goes: nothing confirms routing one charge to multiple sellers, taking a platform cut as part of the split, or reversing or adjusting a split later. Billing profiles set merchant fees, which is a related but different control, and are not credited here. Missing for 10: multi-seller routing, a platform cut within the split, post-hoc split reversal or adjustment, split objects as first-class API resources, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can split one charge among any set of parties — route funds to multiple sellers, take my cut, and reverse or adjust the split later, all as first-class API objects
